headline: Full Canvas Is Not Structural Rigidity: Why Traditional Suits Collapse and AETERNAL’s Independent Tension Vectors Maintain Silhouette
description: The engineering distinction between passive drape and active stress management determines whether a suit holds its form under dynamic load—or fails. This article establishes that traditional Full Canvas is a passive drape system, not an active mechanism for resisting deformation, and introduces AETERNAL's Full Canvas Gravity Matrix as a shift to Active Stress Management Engineering.
